sections.content: All 31 manifest sources have complete single-segment coverage and accepted bounded summaries. No source or page coverage is omitted.
sections.title: Coverage

sections.content: Quick Dev requires strict typed input, hash-bound TDD slices, explicit lifecycle evidence, constrained paths, and non-authorizing decisions. VDD defines plan readiness and lifecycle contracts. Refactor and acceptance guidance requires frozen inputs, deterministic evidence, bounded routes, and repair handling.
sections.title: Skill Guidance

sections.content: AGENTS rules require preserving changes, repository-scoped validation, and fail-closed handling. ADRs define locator, knowledge publication, degraded execution, evidence ownership, and skill-input generation rules. The toolchain repair plan covers selection, transport, coverage, knowledge gates, immutable generations, retention, and end-to-end validation; listed tests and tools are present in the manifest.
sections.title: Repository And Plan
